name: @cutils/ffi
description: Shared scriptc format-7 FFI spec (sqlite's span ABI) plus a Rust struct-echo smoke. Compiles to a single static ELF.

scripts.build:rust: mkdir -p build && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=build/cargo cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=build/cargo cargo build --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && cp build/cargo/release/libcutils_ffi_echo.a build/libcutils_ffi_echo.a && node scripts/copy-shared.mjs build/cargo/release cutils_ffi_echo
scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build:ts && sed 's|"\.\.", "build"|"..", "..", "build"|' test/koffi-binding.mjs > dist/esm/node-binding.mjs && npm run build:elf
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:c && npm run test:node && bash test/elf.test.sh && bash test/consumer-elf.test.sh

author: Joaquin Terrasa & contributors
